_comment: Codex version. Merge the blocks you need into your ~/.codex/hooks.json, and confirm ~/.codex/config.toml has hooks = true. If the same event name already exists, add to its hooks array — don't overwrite the whole section. Codex has a trust mechanism for hooks, so the first activation will ask you to confirm. Restart the session after registering for this to take effect.
_note_matcher: Listing tool names from both platforms in the matcher is intentional. Codex calls editing a file apply_patch and running a command exec or shell, but depending on version and configuration, Write / Edit / Bash can also show up. Casting a wider net is safer than missing one.
